items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff reflects on Mercedes’ non-title years: ‘We weren’t complete losers’
items.summaryEn: Mercedes clinched its ninth constructors' world championship at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and Toto Wolff looked back on the team's four years without a title, saying the squad was not "complete losers."
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫回顾梅赛德斯无冠岁月：“我们并非彻底失败者”
在梅赛德斯锁定第九个车队世界冠军之际，托托·沃尔夫回顾了F1的地面效应时代
2022年的刘易斯·汉密尔顿与乔治·拉塞尔
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫表示，车队在四年无缘F1世界冠军的时期并非“彻底失败者”。
银箭车队周日于巴西大奖赛上夺得他们的第九个车队总冠军，而就在一周前，基米·安东内利成为F1历史上最年轻的世界车手冠军。
随着F1在2026年改用新底盘和动力单元规则，梅赛德斯脱颖而出，但此前的地面效应时代对这支车队而言颇为艰难——2022至2025年间他们仅赢得七场胜利，而仅今年一年就有12场。
“问题是，当你身处这些艰难时刻——就像我们所有人生活中有时也会经历的那样——坚持下去并不容易，”沃尔夫说。“因为事后回看，你会说：‘我们需要这些艰难时刻，才能作为个人成长，或作为组织成长。’但当你身处低谷时，很难有这种感觉。
“所以回看过去，我认为那最后四年非常艰难，先是做错了，然后多少明白为什么错了，接着又意识到，不，我们并没有真正理解。那是一个巨大的反复。
“但当我们10年或20年后回望时，看看统计数据，那四年我们并不是彻底的输家，因为我们连续获得了[第三、第二、第四、第二]。我们赢过比赛，很多比赛。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
“所以单看数字，情况一点也不差，但感觉并不好。车队的韧性——那些在艰难时期团结在一起的人——是一个因素。
“所以锁定这两个冠军感觉真的很好。没有多少运动队能在连续夺冠、然后经历一段困难时期、再卷土重来之后做到这一点。所以我真的很自豪，我们属于在所有体育项目中做到这一点的极少数车队之一。”
梅赛德斯第九次夺得车队总冠军，意味着它在F1历史纪录上追平了威廉姆斯，距离迈凯伦仅差一个冠军。法拉利以16次车队冠军保持纪录。
detailEn: Toto Wolff reflects on Mercedes’ non-title years: ‘We weren’t complete losers’
As Mercedes clinches a ninth constructors’ world championship, Toto Wolff looks back on Formula 1’s ground-effect era of Formula 1
Lewis Hamilton and George Russell in 2022
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff says the squad wasn’t “complete losers” in its four years without a Formula 1 world title.
The Silver Arrows claimed their ninth constructors’ championship on Sunday at the Brazilian Grand Prix, one week after Kimi Antonelli became F1’s youngest world drivers’ champion.

Mercedes came out on top as F1 switched to new chassis and power unit regulations for 2026, but the previous ground-effect era had been tough for the outfit – it took just seven victories from 2022-2025, compared to 12 this year alone.

“The thing is, when you are in these difficult moments, like we all are sometimes in our lives, it's not that easy to keep going,” Wolff said. “Because looking back in retrospect, you're saying, ‘We needed these tough moments in order to grow as people or to grow as an organisation’. But when you're down, that is quite difficult to feel.

“So looking back, I think those last four years were very difficult, between getting it wrong and then kind of understanding why it was wrong and then realising, no, we didn't understand. And that was a big back and forth.

“But we will be looking back in 10 or 20 years, and when you look at the statistics, it wasn't that we were complete losers over those four years, because we finished [third, second, fourth, second successively]. We won races, many races.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
“So it wasn't that bad at all when you look at the sheer numbers, but it felt not good. And the resilience of the team – the people that held together in those tough times – is a factor.

“So it feels really good sealing those two titles. Not many sports teams have done that after a consecutive run of championships, then a difficult spell, and then coming back. So I'm really proud that we are part of this very small group of teams that have done that in all sports.”
Mercedes’ ninth constructors’ title means it has equalled Williams in F1’s history books and is just one crown away from McLaren. Ferrari is the record holder with 16 championship victories.

items.originalTitle: Laurent Mekies: Brazil was Isack Hadjar’s “best race” for Red Bull
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies described Isack Hadjar's third-place finish at the 2026 São Paulo Grand Prix as his "best race" with the team.
detailZh: 洛朗·梅基斯：巴西站是伊萨克·哈贾尔在红牛的“最佳比赛”
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯称赞伊萨克·哈贾尔在巴西站的登台表现是他在车队中的“最佳比赛”
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
2026年圣保罗大奖赛对红牛车队而言是一个意义重大的周末。马克斯·维斯塔潘从第21位发车、以不可思议的追击最终获得第二名，抢走了头条；而他的队友伊萨克·哈贾尔则悄然交出了车队领队洛朗·梅基斯眼中他迄今最令人印象深刻的一场驾驶。
哈贾尔为米尔顿凯恩斯的车队锁定了双领奖台，他从第五位发车，在英特拉格斯获得第三名，巩固了他2026赛季第三次登上领奖台的成绩。但据梅基斯所说，真正引人注目的不仅仅是最终结果，而是这位年轻法国车手在快速变化、险恶的条件下展现出的纯粹速度和比赛技巧。
当被问及哈贾尔是否即将在合适的环境下挑战分站冠军时，梅基斯毫不吝惜赞美之词。
“我认为，如果你现在问我，我觉得这是他与我们一起跑得最好的一场比赛，”梅基斯在赛后对记者说。“就纯粹速度而言，这正是我们所关注的，你知道，在干地上、在半雨胎条件下、在极其困难的条件下展现出的纯粹速度，以及他在比赛中的聪明才智。”
哈贾尔在英特拉格斯的表现进一步证明了红牛确认他参加2027赛季的决定是正确的。梅基斯指出，这种稳步提升的轨迹正是车队在锁定他未来时所寄望的。
梅基斯解释道：“如你所知，他今年跑了很多场非常强劲的比赛……但我认为他又一次提高了标杆，你知道这就是我们想继续看到的。”“你知道，这就是我们在决定确认他2027年席位时印象最深刻的地方，就是他一直在不断提高标杆，我们只是希望能为他提供继续做到这一点的环境。”
哈贾尔在比赛中相当长的一段时间里，在相同轮胎策略下追平或超过了维斯塔潘的速度，证明他具备在发车格最前方竞速的速度。
比赛中红牛车库的主要话题之一涉及车队指令。第38圈时，哈贾尔正跑在第二位，他接到指令让维斯塔潘——当时正在从后方一路追赶——超过他。在无线电中，哈贾尔询问如果维斯塔潘追不上领先的诺里斯，位置是否会换回来。
梅基斯直接回应了无线电通话，确认换回位置绝对在考虑之中，但这场混乱比赛的实际情况最终阻止了这一点。
“是的，我认为如果赛车一直保持接近，我们本来会这么做的；我们本来会做的，”梅基斯透露。“因为伊萨克的速度非常强劲，而且他一直紧跟着马克斯，正如我们在换位之后看到的那样。”
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
但随着圈数逐渐减少，圣保罗的天气又抛出了新的变数。
“但后来，随着比赛推进、雨又下起来，赛车之间距离非常非常远，那样做就没有意义了，再加上最后雨势加大，那样做也完全没有意义，”梅基斯解释道。
尽管没有进行反向交换，梅基斯仍称赞了两位车手展现出的团队合作。
“但我必须说，马克斯和伊萨克非常、非常紧密地合作，才在这条赛道上取得了最佳结果，”这位红牛车队负责人总结道。
2026赛季（希望）还剩三站比赛，哈贾尔日益增长的自信和原始速度表明，红牛已经为其未来锁定了一位能力出众的车手。
detailEn: Laurent Mekies: Brazil was Isack Hadjar’s “best race” for Red Bull
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies praises Isack Hadjar's podium drive in Brazil as his "best race" with the team
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

The 2026 São Paulo Grand Prix was a monumental weekend for Red Bull Racing. While Max Verstappen stole the headlines with a logic-defying charge from 21st to finish second, his team-mate Isack Hadjar quietly delivered what team principal Laurent Mekies believes is his most impressive drive yet.

Securing a double podium for the Milton Keynes squad, Hadjar finished third at Interlagos after starting fifth, cementing his third podium appearance of the 2026 season. But according to Mekies, it wasn't just the final result that stood out, it was the raw pace and racecraft the young Frenchman displayed in rapidly changing, treacherous conditions.
When asked if Hadjar is on the verge of challenging for outright wins in the right circumstances, Mekies didn't hold back his praise.

"I think ultimately if you ask me right now, I think it’s the best race he has done with us," Mekies told reporters following the race. "In terms of pure pace, and that’s what we look at, you know, pure pace on the dry, on the inters, super difficult conditions, in how clever he has been racing."

Hadjar's performance at Interlagos adds further justification to Red Bull's decision to confirm him for the 2027 season. Mekies noted that this steady trajectory of improvement is exactly what the team was banking on when it secured his future.

"He has done a lot of very strong racing this year as you know... but I think he has raised the bar another time, so you know that’s what we want to keep seeing," Mekies explained. "You know that’s what we said we were most impressed by when we took the decisions to confirm him for '27 is the way he has been keeping raising the bar, and we were simply hoping to [provide] the environment for him to keep doing that."
Hadjar spent a significant portion of the race matching or exceeding Verstappen's pace on the same tyre strategy, proving he has the speed to run at the very front of the grid.

One of the major talking points from the Red Bull garage during the race involved a team order. On lap 38, Hadjar was running in second place when he was instructed to let Verstappen - who was charging through the field on a recovery drive - pass him. Over the radio, Hadjar asked if the positions would be swapped back if Verstappen couldn't catch race leader Lando Norris.
Mekies addressed the radio traffic directly, confirming that a swap-back was absolutely on the table, but the circumstances of the chaotic race ultimately prevented it.

"Yeah, I think we would have done it if the car had stayed close together; we would have done it," Mekies revealed. "Because Isack had a very strong pace and he stayed with Max, as we have seen after the swap."
Lando Norris, McLaren, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
But as the laps ticked down, the weather in São Paulo threw another curve ball.

"But then, as the race panned out and the rain came again, the cars were, you know, very, very distant, and it would not have made sense, plus the increase rain intensity at the end, like it would not have made any sense," Mekies clarified.
Despite the lack of a reverse swap, Mekies praised the teamwork displayed by both drivers.
"But I have to say Max and Isack worked very, very strongly together to get the best of the circuit," the Red Bull boss concluded.
With three rounds (hopefully) remaining in the 2026 season, Hadjar's growing confidence and raw speed suggest that Red Bull has secured a highly capable driver for its future.

detailZh: F1学院冠军Alisha Palmowski透露从维斯塔潘那里学到的关键教训
红牛青训车队表示，维斯塔潘的心态帮助她在整个周末的比赛中得到发展
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，获取F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的分析与赛事解读。
Alisha Palmowski表示，她在F1学院冠军赛季最大的教训就是简单地观察四届F1冠军维斯塔潘的工作。
这位英国车手作为红牛青训项目的一部分，代表卡马索斯车队参赛，在奥斯汀赢得了2026年F1学院冠军，尽管整个女子赛车系列赛还有一轮比赛尚未进行。
帕尔莫夫斯基在2024年卡塔尔站以外卡身份首次亮相F1学院。随后，她与卡马索斯车队签订了2025赛季的全职合同，成为红牛支持的车手。卡马索斯和红牛都保留了这位20岁的年轻车手参加2026赛季。
作为米尔顿凯恩斯车队的一员，帕尔莫夫斯基有机会在周末比赛中接触到该队的明星车手，她说这位荷兰人总是乐于助人。
“我认为这是一项非常考验心理的体育运动，比很多人想象的要困难得多，这也是我最钦佩马克斯的地方，”她在天空体育的访谈中说道。
“你知道吗，他的心态，他的侵略性和永不放弃的态度。我认为比赛中任何情况都可能发生，但马克斯总能从赛车中榨取出110%的性能，这是我非常钦佩的地方。”
“我并不是在将自己与马克斯相比较，我的意思是我在他的水平上，但我确实非常钦佩他，并仰慕他，希望有一天我能接近他。”
除了在F1学院的时间，帕尔莫夫斯基还参加了Ginetta 青训锦标赛和GB4锦标赛。她参加了2024年Formula E女子测试，为Envision Racing驾驶。帕尔莫夫斯基尚未确认她在2027年将做什么。”
2026年F1学院赛季将在拉斯维加斯结束，届时它将作为F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末的一部分。”
detailEn: F1 Academy champion Alisha Palmowski reveals key lesson from Max Verstappen
The Red Bull junior says Max Verstappen’s mentality helped her develop across race weekends
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Alisha Palmowski says the biggest lesson of her F1 Academy title year came from simply watching four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen at work.
The Briton, who races for Campos Racing as part of Red Bull's junior programme, clinched the 2026 F1 Academy title in Austin, with one round still to run in the all-female racing series.

Palmowski made her F1 Academy debut as the wildcard entry in Qatar in 2024. She subsequently signed a full-time contract with Campos Racing for the 2025 season as the Red Bull-supported driver. Both Campos and Red Bull retained the 20-year-old for 2026.
Being part of the Milton Keynes outfit has given Palmowski access to its star driver across race weekends, and she says the Dutchman has always been quick to help.
"I think it's a really mentally challenging sport, more than a lot of people realise, and I think that's what I admire most about Max," she told talkSPORT.

"You know, his mentality, his aggression and his never-give-up attitude. I think anything can happen in a race, but Max is always able to extract 110% out of the car, and that's something that I really admire.
"And I'm not comparing myself to Max in the sense that I'm saying I'm on his level, but I definitely admire and look up to him, and wish that one day I'll be anywhere near him."

In addition to her time in F1 Academy, Palmowski has raced in the Ginetta Junior Championship and the GB4 Championship. She took part in the 2024 Formula E women's test, driving for Envision Racing. Palmowski is yet to confirm what she will do in 2027.
The 2026 F1 Academy season will conclude in Las Vegas, where it will feature as part of the F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend.

items.originalTitle: Hearing set for Audi Tsunoda appeal
detailZh: 国际汽联宣布，奥迪对土屋圭市在意大利大奖赛上未受到处罚的申诉将于11月25日听取。
奥迪在蒙扎赛事后对规则对土屋圭市在发车时的所谓越位违规的适用感到不公，提出了投诉。
土屋圭市原本应该排在第14位发车，但在最初错误地驶向第15位发车位后，他在最后一刻转向了右侧。
虽然他能够在预定发车位内停车，因此没有越过前方发车位，但他的小红牛赛车最终以一个角度停在了那里。
那足以让赛事总监鲁伊·马奎斯决定进行另一圈发车圈，因为根据后来的 stewards 文件，"他表示他不舒服以那样的位置开始比赛"。
土佐的行动触发了一场 FIA stewards 的调查，因为造成额外发车圈的车手被认为违反了规则。
任何造成额外发车圈但能够完成该圈的车手必须"在圈尾进入维修区，并从维修区末端开始[练习]"。
由于土佐没有完成这个动作，F1 的体育规则规定，任何未执行的停站和出发处罚将被转换为30秒的赛后时间处罚。
小红牛 然而，认为车手小岛没有造成额外的起步圈数——因为他仍然在自己的格子内，并且没有影响到其他车手。
裁判组接受了这一观点，并认为小岛本人并非额外起步圈数的“原因”——这实际上是马奎斯自己选择的结果。
不过，奥迪提出了抗议，因为它认为小岛确实是额外起步圈数的催化剂。
它在蒙扎之后发表了一份简短的声明，称其“对B5.9.4条款的应用提出了关切。”
如果曾田被处罚，奥迪将从中受益，因为30秒的处罚将使他降至第15位，而加布里埃尔·博尔特罗托将被提升至第10位。
现在，这个问题将在11月25日在巴黎的FIA国际法庭上审理。应FIA的要求，听证将在闭门进行，因此公众和媒体将不允许参加。
detailEn: The FIA has announced that Audi’s appeal against Yuki Tsunoda not getting a penalty at Formula 1’s Italian Grand Prix will be heard on November 25.
Audi complained after the Monza race for what it felt was an incorrect application of the rules against Tsunoda for an alleged grid infringement at the restart.
Tsunoda had been due to line up 14th but, after mistakenly initially heading towards the 15th-place grid slot, he veered at the last-minute to the right-hand side.
While he was able to come to a stop within his intended grid slot, so therefore was not out of position over the front, his Racing Bulls car had ended up at an angle.

That was enough for race director Rui Marques to decide to go for another formation lap because, according to a later stewards' document, "he stated he was not comfortable starting the race with the car in that position".
Tsunoda’s actions had triggered an FIA stewards’ investigation because drivers that cause an extra formation lap are deemed to be in breach of the rules.
Any driver who causes an additional formation lap but is able to start that lap is required to "enter the pitlane at the end of the lap and must start the [session] from the end of the pitlane".
With Tsunoda not serving that, F1's sporting regulations state that any unserved stop-and-go penalty is converted to a 30-second post-race time penalty.
Racing Bulls argued, however, that Tsunoda had not caused the extra formation lap - as he was still within his grid box and was not impacting any other drivers.
The stewards accepted that position and felt that Tsunoda himself had not been the “cause” of the extra formation lap – which was instead down to Marques’ own choice.
Audi complained, though, as it felt that Tsunoda had indeed been the catalyst for the extra formation lap.
It said in a short statement after Monza that it had "raised a concern regarding the application of Article B5.9.4".
Audi would stand to benefit were Tsunoda to be penalised, because a 30-second sanction would drop him to 15th - with Gabriel Bortoleto being promoted to 10th.

The matter will now be heard at the FIA’s International Court of Appeal in Paris on November 25. The hearing will take place behind closed doors at the request of the FIA, so no public nor media will be allowed to attend.

items.summaryEn: Red Bull has named Nikola Tsolov as the official reserve driver for both of its Formula 1 teams in 2027, with a programme designed to prepare him for a race seat. Tsolov missed out on a 2027 Racing Bulls seat as Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad both received extensions.
detailZh: 红牛宣布尼古拉·措洛夫为2027年两支F1车队的官方储备车手，并为其制定了一项“旨在确保他完全准备好以最高水平参加F1比赛”的计划。
由于利亚姆·劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德均获续约至明年，措洛夫无缘2027年小红牛的正赛车手席位。
但红牛明确表示，措洛夫仍是F1席位的下一位候选车手；在确认劳森和林德布拉德2027年席位的同一天，红牛也确认措洛夫将出任储备车手。
措洛夫目前正与2027年哈斯F1车手拉斐尔·卡马拉以及亚历克斯·邓恩争夺F2年度冠军，已取得六场胜利，赛季还剩卡塔尔和阿布扎比两站。
措洛夫在去年的第三个F3赛季中获得亚军，仅次于卡马拉。
红牛公告写道：“在新角色中，尼古拉将参与一项广泛的培养计划，将模拟器与研发工作，同通过自由练习赛、旧车测试（TPC）、部分测试环节以及轮胎测试所获得的有价值的赛道经验结合起来。”
“除了作为储备车手的职责外，该计划旨在确保他为以最高水平参加F1比赛做好充分准备。”
措洛夫表示，他对红牛给予的机会感到“无比高兴和感激”。
“我的目标很明确：我想成为一名F1车手，”他说。
“有机会在明年为下一步做准备，这令人无比兴奋。我相信，在车队的支持与经验帮助下，我将获得尽可能最好的准备，确保当时机到来时，我已完全准备好迈上F1发车格，踏出下一步。”
措洛夫在墨西哥站的FP1首秀中给小红牛留下了深刻印象，当时他的表现与2026年新秀林德布拉德相比毫不逊色。
“尼科拉是一位极具天赋的年轻车手，过去几年他的成长和表现给我们留下了极为深刻的印象，”红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯说道。
“在F3为冠军而战，如今在首个完整赛季就挑战F2年度冠军，这充分说明了他的能力和决心。
“同样令我们印象深刻的是他的成熟、他的比赛方式，以及他不断学习和进步的意愿。
“我们对尼科拉（Nikola）的潜力抱有极大信心，认为他是一位在F1拥有非常光明未来的车手。
“这一任命体现了我们对他的信任，以及对他持续发展的承诺。我们在2027年的重点将是给予他所需的经验、工具和支持，让他为下赛季征战F1做好准备。”
detailEn: Red Bull has named Nikola Tsolov the official reserve driver of both of its Formula 1 teams in 2027 with a programme “designed to ensure he is fully prepared to race in F1 at the highest level”.
Tsolov missed out on a 2027 Racing Bulls seat as Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad were both handed extensions into next year.
But Red Bull has made clear Tsolov is still very much the next driver in line for an F1 seat, confirming on the same day Lawson and Lindblad were confirmed for 2027 that Tsolov would be made reserve.
Tsolov is currently fighting for the Formula 2 title with 2027 Haas F1 driver Rafael Camara and Alex Dunne, having taken six race wins with two rounds in Qatar and Abu Dhabi remaining.
Tsolov finished runner-up to Camara in his third Formula 3 campaign last year.

Red Bull's announcement read: “In his new role, Nikola will undertake an extensive development programme, combining simulator and development work with valuable track experience through Free Practice sessions, Testing of Previous Cars (TPC), selected test sessions and tyre testing.
“Alongside his responsibilities as a reserve driver, the programme is designed to ensure he is fully prepared to race in F1 at the highest level.”
Tsolov said he was “incredibly happy and grateful” to Red Bull for the opportunity.
“My ambition is clear: I want to become an F1 driver,” he said.

“Having the opportunity to spend next year preparing for that next step is incredibly exciting. I’m confident that with the team’s support and experience, I’ll have the best possible preparation to make sure I’m fully ready to take the next step onto the F1 grid when the time comes.”
Tsolov impressed Racing Bulls with his FP1 debut in Mexico where he compared favourably to 2026 rookie Lindblad.
“Nikola is an exceptionally talented young driver, and we have been hugely impressed by his development and performances over the past few years,” Red Bull team boss Laurent Mekies said.
“To fight for the championship in F3 and now challenge for the F2 title in his first full season says a great deal about his ability and determination.
“What has impressed us just as much is his maturity, his approach to racing and his willingness to keep learning and improving.
“We have enormous belief in Nikola’s potential and see him as a driver with a very exciting future in F1.

“This appointment reflects our confidence in him and our commitment to his continued development. Our focus in 2027 will be on giving him the experience, tools and support he needs to be ready to race in F1 next.”

“我们对尼科拉的潜力抱有极大的信心，认为他是一位在F1拥有非常令人兴奋未来的车手。

detailEn: Tsolov named Red Bull, Racing Bulls reserve driver after missing out on 2027 F1 race seat
Tsolov will undertake a rigorous development programme to prepare for the step up to F1
Nikola Tsolov has been named as reserve driver for both Red Bull and Racing Bulls for the 2027 Formula 1 season having missed out on a full-time drive.

The 19-year-old Bulgarian had been linked to a step up from F2 to replace Liam Lawson at Racing Bulls in 2027, but after weeks of speculation the Faenza-based squad put rumours to rest by confirming the New Zealander would continue alongside Arvid Lindblad.
Tsolov has impressed in his first full F2 season, claiming six victories which include four feature races and a streak that saw him become the first in series history to claim three on the bounce.

Next year he will take on a reserve and development role that, alongside the potential to act as a substitute in case of emergency - as Yuki Tsunoda did at Racing Bulls when Lawson was called upon to replace the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull - Tsolov will undergo an extensive programme that will combine simulator work with on-track experience, gained through FP1 and TPC [Testing of Previous Car] sessions, as well as Pirelli tyre tests.
“Nikola is an exceptionally talented young driver, and we have been hugely impressed by his development and performances over the past few years," said Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies.

"To fight for the championship in F3 and now challenge for the F2 title in his first full season says a great deal about his ability and determination. What has impressed us just as much is his maturity, his approach to racing and his willingness to keep learning and improving.
"We have enormous belief in Nikola’s potential and see him as a driver with a very exciting future in F1.

“This appointment reflects our confidence in him and our commitment to his continued development. Our focus in 2027 will be on giving him the experience, tools and support he needs to be ready to race in F1 next.
"For now, Nikola still has an important job to finish in F2. We wish him every success in the final two rounds and will be supporting him all the way as he fights for the championship."

Tsolov sits second in the F2 standings and is seven points behind leader Rafael Camara with two rounds remaining, though the Brazilian could yet miss those if continuing with Haas - who he will race for next year - having stepped up to make his debut at Interlagos following Esteban Ocon's departure.

Tsolov added: "I’m incredibly happy and grateful to Red Bull for giving me this opportunity. Since joining the junior team, I’ve received amazing support and have developed so much, both as a driver and as a person. My career has progressed incredibly quickly, and I owe a lot to everyone who has believed in me and helped me get to this point.

"My ambition is clear: I want to become an F1 driver. Having the opportunity to spend next year preparing for that next step is incredibly exciting. I’m confident that with the team’s support and experience, I’ll have the best possible preparation to make sure I’m fully ready to take the next step onto the F1 grid when the time comes.

"I know there is still a lot to learn, but I’m ready to work hard, make the most of every opportunity and give everything I have to the Team. For now, my immediate focus is on finishing the F2 season as strongly as possible.”

法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔驳斥了刘易斯·汉密尔顿与查尔斯·勒克莱尔之间持续存在摩擦的猜测，并确认这两位车手在圣保罗大奖赛前进行了一次私下面对面讨论，解决了他们之间的问题。

detailEn: Fred Vasseur: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc “left my room joking together”

Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur has shut down speculation of ongoing friction between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, confirming the two drivers resolved their issues during a private sit-down discussion ahead of the São Paulo Grand Prix.

The internal dynamic at Ferrari has been under scrutiny following the team's opening-lap clash in Mexico, but the chaotic, rain-soaked race at Interlagos passed without any radio arguments or disputes over position swapping between the two drivers.
Speaking to the media post-race, Vasseur confirmed that a preemptive meeting was the catalyst for the smooth operation.
"Honestly, we had a good discussion on Friday. We cleared the situation," Vasseur explained. "I think we did a good reset on the mindset, and they left my room joking together."

While it remains to be seen if the harmony will hold through the final stretch of the season, Vasseur was visibly relieved by the outcome of the talks.
"It's good, and I hope the things will last and stay like this, but we had a good meeting on Thursday," Vasseur added.

The Ferrari boss was in good spirits following the race, even using his trademark dry humour to deflect questions about the intense pressure on the pitwall. When a journalist pressed him on a specific high-stress strategy moment - asking on what lap it occurred and if the cars were still on intermediate tyres - Vasseur completely bypassed the race data.

"No, no, no, guys. This is 6:30, it's when I did my sport," Vasseur deadpanned, referring to his morning workout. "And then I made a mega lap. No confusion. The conclusion is that I'm much more stressed when I'm doing sport."

以下是我们团队对留下劳森和林德布拉德、而不将F2争冠车手尼古拉·措洛夫提升为正式车手的看法。
一个关乎存亡的问题得到了回答。
很少有车手决定像劳森从小红牛获得新合同这样让人觉得理所当然。
他今年表现非常出色。是的，还有一些粗糙之处需要打磨，但他整年都很快，始终强劲，提供了工程师们喜爱的技术反馈，并且出色地屏蔽了所有关于他未来的质疑噪音。
在艾伦·珀曼的带领下，这支车队能否独立自主、做出自己的决定，并规划一条只专注于让自己变得更好的道路？
还是说它只是姊妹车队红牛的傀儡，是未来车手的测试场和培训学校，即使这意味着让新秀匆忙上位会带来一些短期阵痛？
在劳森经历了这样的赛季之后，小红牛放弃他并抛弃已经积累的所有良好势头是毫无道理的。所以暂时留住他给了我们关于小红牛定位的答案。
措洛夫在F1有着光明的未来，但时间站在他这边，让他能够迈出那一步。
很确定这是对小红牛最好的决定，也是未来对红牛最好的决定。
劳森和林德布拉德——别忘了，后者还是个新秀——都已经证明，当比赛周末一切按计划进行时，他们能够带回成绩。
两人都有能力在伊萨克·哈贾尔或马克斯·维斯塔潘中任何一人踩到香蕉皮滑倒时成为替补。红牛清楚劳森在需要时能带来什么，所以他是衡量林德布拉德潜在贡献的一个很好的参照。
让措洛夫在幕后待命并参加几节第一次自由练习赛，将为他2028年正式登场做好准备。
就我而言，这对所有相关方都是正确的决定。
如果小红牛想被真正视为一支独立的F1车队，拥有自己的雄心、梦想等等，而不是纯粹的红牛人才农场，那么是的，劳森基本上必须留下。
措洛夫未来可能会更快。据我们所知，他可能已经更快了。但劳森今年提供的那种高效得分能力，新秀是无法匹敌的——我认为这是F1的一条规律。
因此，用措洛夫替换劳森，将赤裸裸地牺牲小红牛的现在来换取红牛主队的未来，而每一个这样的决定都会让红牛在F1拥有两支车队变得越来越难以接受。
只有小红牛拥有自己的抱负，它才可能被允许继续存在，而给劳森一份新合同在我看来能换来一些可信度。
马尔科早就该放弃劳森了
在他权力鼎盛时期，赫尔穆特·马尔科早就把劳森抛弃了。
劳森曾有机会进入顶级车队，但没能成功，而且很可能不会再得到那样的机会了。
现在马尔科不再掌权，这是迄今为止最明显的迹象，表明小红牛不是红牛二队；培养年轻车手不再是这支车队的唯一目标，甚至不是主要目标。
你不能怪红牛。小红牛如今是一个价值数十亿美元的实体，而不是像红牛二队那样一支运营起来既费钱又亏钱的车队。在如今的F1商业环境里，制造商锦标赛的最终排名已不再是衡量价值的唯一标准。
在一支以接受亏损为前提建立起来的车队身上冒险是一回事。在一支价值数十亿美元的车队身上冒险则是另一回事。
这一切并非批评其所作决定，因为劳森是一位配得上F1的车手。这只是为了指出更多证据，表明小红牛正像一支独立车队那样运作和管理。
劳森明智的话应寻找退路
劳森现在处境极佳，是本赛季的明星车手之一，但他应该已经开始考虑2028年的退路了。
措洛夫明年将在旁等待机会，小红牛没有理由不会在2028年面临完全相同的“三选二”难题。
这一次劳森是压倒性的合理人选，下一次他可能就不是了，而且鉴于红牛会把那些决定拖到赛季后期才做，他不想突然在2028年落得没有席位。
所以他明智的做法是尝试效仿皮埃尔·加斯利和卡洛斯·塞恩斯的先例，在红牛认定你已无用之前另寻出路。
我很欣赏这段职业生涯救赎的弧线。
在我看来，劳森效力红牛一队始终显得格格不入，从官宣那一刻起就是如此。我确实没看到任何迹象表明他能解决车队的二号车手难题。
红牛随后把事情搞砸了，这也没帮上忙，但那段不幸的两场比赛经历本可能成为劳森F1生涯走向终结的开端。
然而，接下来发生的一切充分揭示了他的心理韧性——因为在过去20个月里他不得不消化许多事情，却始终镇定自若。
为顶级车队驾驶是每位车手都渴望的，但这并非必须成为全部和终极目标；如果你没能做到，也并不会自动让你的职业生涯就此崩塌。
劳森今年已经有力地证明了自己配得上F1的一席之地。因此，这次续约是唯一可以接受的结果。
detailEn: Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad will continue to race for Racing Bulls in 2027, with Red Bull electing against what would have been a huge Formula 1 driver sacking.
Here's what our team makes of the move to keep Lawson and Lindblad and not promote Formula 2 title contender Nikola Tsolov into a race seat.
An existential question has been answered
Very few driver decisions have felt as right as Lawson getting a fresh contract with Racing Bulls.

He has been superb this year. Yes, there are still some rough edges to smooth out, but he has been fast throughout, consistently strong, delivering technical input that his engineers have loved, and brilliantly able to shut out all the noise regarding the doubts over his future.
Is it an outfit that, under Alan Permane, can stand on its own two feet, take its own decisions and plot a path that is only focused on making itself better?
Or is it simply a puppet for sister squad Red Bull, a testing ground and training school for its future drivers, even if that means some short-term pain in rushing rookies through?

After the season Lawson has had, it would have made no sense for Racing Bulls to drop him and throw away all the good momentum it has built up. So keeping him for now gives us the answer about what Racing Bulls is about.
Tsolov has a bright future in F1, but time is on his side to make that step up.
Pretty sure this is the best decision for Racing Bulls and in the future for Red Bull.
Both Lawson and Lindblad - a rookie, let's not forget - have shown that they can bring home the results when everything goes as planned over a race weekend.

Both are capable of being a replacement for Isack Hadjar or Max Verstappen if either of them slip on a banana skin. Red Bull knows what Lawson can bring to them if required, so he is a good measure of what Lindblad could potentially bring too.
Having Tsolov in the background and doing a few FP1 sessions will prepare him for an introduction in 2028.
As far as I'm concerned, it's the correct decision for all involved.

If Racing Bulls is to be at all seen as an F1 team in its own right, with its own ambitions and dreams and what have you, rather than a pure Red Bull talent farm, then yeah, Lawson pretty much had to be kept on.

Tsolov may end up faster down the line. For all we know, he may be faster already. But the kind of efficient scoring that Lawson has provided this year a rookie cannot match - I would say that's a rule in F1.

So Tsolov-for-Lawson would be nakedly sacrificing Racing Bulls's present for the senior Red Bull team's future, and every decision like that makes it less and less palatable for Red Bull to own two teams in F1.
Only if Racing Bulls has its own aspirations can it be allowed to continue, and a new deal for Lawson buys some credibility in my eyes.
Marko would have dropped Lawson long ago
At the height of his powers, Helmut Marko would have ditched Lawson ages ago.
Lawson had his shot at the top team, didn't make it, and will likely not be given that chance again.
Now Marko's no longer in charge, and this is the biggest indicator yet that Racing Bulls is not Toro Rosso; developing young drivers is no longer the only, or primary, end goal for this team.

You can't blame Red Bull. Instead of a team that cost and lost money to run like Toro Rosso, Racing Bulls is now a multi-billion dollar entity. Constructors' championship finishing position is not the only definition of value in an F1 business anymore.
Taking risks with a team built with the acceptance of losing money is one thing. Taking risks with a team worth billions is another.
None of this is to criticise the decision it has made, as Lawson is a worthy F1 driver. It's just to point out yet more evidence that Racing Bulls is acting and being run like its own team.
Lawson would be wise to find an exit route
Lawson is in a fantastic position now and has been one of the star drivers of the season, but he should already be thinking about exit routes for 2028.
Tsolov is going to be waiting in the wings next year, and there's no reason why Racing Bulls might be faced with the exact same 'three into two' dilemma for 2028.

This time Lawson was the overwhelmingly logical pick, next time he might not be and, given Red Bull leaves those decisions until late in the season, he doesn't want to suddenly be left without a seat for 2028.
So he'd be wise to try to follow the Pierre Gasly and Carlos Sainz playbook of finding another driver before Red Bull decides it's done with you.
I've got a lot of time for this career redemption arc.

Lawson at the Red Bull senior team always felt like an uncomfortable fit to me, right from when it was announced. I certainly hadn't seen anything to suggest he would solve the team's second-driver problem.
Red Bull's bungling of what followed didn't help, but that ill-fated, two-race spell could've marked the beginning of the end of Lawson's F1 career.
Instead, what's followed has revealed plenty about his mental resolve - because he's had to process a lot these past 20 months yet has been absolutely unflappable.
Driving for the top teams is what every driver craves, but it doesn't have to be the be-all and end-all and, if you don't make it, it doesn't automatically consign you to career collapse.
Lawson's proved emphatically this year that he deserves a place in F1. This contract extension was therefore the only acceptable outcome.

detailZh: 支撑着利亚姆·劳森职业生涯挽救性F1赛季的令人印象深刻的统计数据
利亚姆·劳森的稳定性使他成为小红牛车队在2026年一级方程式赛季中如此宝贵的资产
小红牛车队终于宣布利亚姆·劳森和阿尔维德·林德布拉德将留队参加2027赛季，结束了长期的不确定，因为车队和更广泛的红牛公司权衡是否让劳森再留队一年，或者提升下一个潜力股，F2领跑者尼古拉·索洛夫
劳森今年获得了89分，其中75分来自小红牛车队，14分是在受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔缺席三场比赛时获得的，他在小红牛车队确保其最佳 Constructors' championship 结果中发挥了关键作用，仅靠阿尔卑斯山的奇迹才让车队未能锁定第五名
但是，原本看似简单的向前一步决策，由于小红牛的双重动机而变得越来越复杂。一方面，它的主要存在理由仍然是寻找下一个马克斯·维斯塔潘或基米·安东内利。安东内利展示了早些时候晋升到一级方程式的价值——20岁时的艰难学习年最终导致了毁灭性的冠军争夺战——一些高管渴望看到Tsolov能够快速晋升以最大化他的成长。
但小红牛还肩负着在商业和赛道表现上独立自主的双重任务。因此，获得第五名的奖金对这支英意车队来说是一个巨大的提升，该队在近年来对其基础设施进行了大量投资。
这就是劳森发挥作用的地方。他的2026年表现对车队至关重要，他新发现的稳定性——尽管在赛季中有一段时间在红牛车队代表哈贾尔参赛——为车队提供了一个稳定的基准来评估新秀Lindblad的进步。现在，这一趋势预计将在2027年继续，Tsolov将担任预备车手角色，包括增加的私人测试、新秀FP1练习和模拟器任务。

劳森在中场位置上以20场比赛中获得15个前十名成绩和仅一次DSQ的成绩领先
*哈达尔因手腕骨折缺席了三场比赛。

detailEn: The impressive stats underpinning Liam Lawson's career-saving F1 season
How Liam Lawson's consistency made him such a valuable asset to Racing Bulls in the 2026 Formula 1 season

Racing Bulls has finally announced Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad will stay put for the 2027 season, ending a long-running saga as the team and the wider Red Bull company weighed up keeping Lawson on board for another year or promoting the next prospect in the pipeline, F2 frontrunner Nikola Tsolov.

Lawson scored 89 points this year, 75 for Racing Bulls and 14 standing in for the injured Isack Hadjar for three races, as he played a pivotal role in Racing Bulls securing its best-ever constructors' championship result, with only an Alpine miracle keeping the team from locking up fifth.

But what felt like a straightforward forward decision became increasingly complex given Racing Bulls' dual motives. On one hand, its main raison d'etre is still to find the next Max Verstappen or Kimi Antonelli, too. With Antonelli demonstrating the value of an early promotion to F1 - a tough learning year leading to a devastating title campaign aged 20 - some executives were keen to see Tsolov fast-tracked to maximise his growth.

But Racing Bulls is also tasked to stand on its own two feet both commercially and in terms of on-track performance. Therefore, taking the prize money attached to fifth place is a huge boost for the Anglo-Italian team, which has significantly invested in its infrastructure in recent years.

That's where Lawson comes in. His 2026 performances have been so crucial to the team, and his newfound consistency - despite a mid-season three-race run at Red Bull to deputise for Hadjar - has given the team a solid benchmark to evaluate the progress of rookie Lindblad. That is now set to continue in 2027, with Tsolov set for a reserve role that includes an increased workload of private testing, rookie FP1 sessions and simulator duties.
The following stats really demonstrate why Lawson has simply been too good and too valuable for the team to overlook.
*75 points for Racing Bulls, not counting the 14 points Lawson scored for Red Bull
Lawson also leads the midfield in number of grand prix points finishes with 15 top 10 results in 20 races and just a single DNF.
*Hadjar missed three races due to a wrist fracture.

detailZh: 拉尔夫·舒马赫质疑汉密尔顿的领导力，并对维斯塔潘发出警告
拉尔夫·舒马赫认为，维斯塔潘在梅赛德斯会难以适应，并批评了汉密尔顿带领车队的能力
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、法拉利、马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
前一级方程式车手拉尔夫·舒马赫认为，马克斯·维斯塔潘会觉得在梅赛德斯的生活“非常艰难”，并辩称刘易斯·汉密尔顿从未学会如何管理一支车队。
在天空体育德国台的《Backstage Boxengasse》播客节目中，舒马赫表示，维斯塔潘深度参与红牛技术层面的事务，这种模式很可能不容易移植到梅赛德斯这样的另一支车队。
“我认为那会非常困难，”这位德国人说道。“马克斯习惯了（一些不同的东西）……他对技术如此敏锐，他想确切知道发生了什么。
“他基本上坐进赛车就想立刻知道变速箱、差速器的情况。或者比如减震器是如何工作的。无论如何，他都会觉得深入探究这些很有意思。”
舒马赫将这一点归因于维斯塔潘与父亲、前F1车手乔斯·维斯塔潘共同成长的经历，并将其与自己与哥哥、七届世界冠军迈克尔·舒马赫一起度过的童年进行了比较。
“而且马克斯也属于与父亲一起成长起来的那一代人，他父亲亲自参与赛车调校，就像我和我哥哥那样，”他补充道，“我认为这就是最大的区别。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利；刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
他怀疑梅赛德斯不会欢迎那种影响力，并认为法拉利会更适合。
“他毕竟是和谁一起成长起来的？是和红牛一起。梅赛德斯已经是一支大车队了。如果像马克斯这样的人现在去那里，我不认为他们会太热衷。”
“在法拉利，我认为他们习惯了车手能够提出要求，但在我看来，这仍然源自迈克尔[舒马赫]，源自他在那里留下的东西。”
法拉利的车手阵容动态在最近几场比赛中受到了审视。舒马赫对汉密尔顿在马拉内罗车队的表现毫不留情地做出了评价。
“汉密尔顿从未学会如何领导一支车队，无论是在托托·沃尔夫手下还是在罗恩·丹尼斯手下，”这位前车手说。“那本来也从来不是他的工作。他只需要坐进车里，尽可能快地驾驶。”
“我觉得你能看出来，而且我认为这也让他变得相当自负。”
detailEn: Ralf Schumacher questions Lewis Hamilton's leadership as he issues Max Verstappen warning
Ralf Schumacher believes Max Verstappen would struggle to fit in at Mercedes and has criticised Lewis Hamilton's ability to lead a team
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Former Formula 1 driver Ralf Schumacher believes Max Verstappen would find life at Mercedes "very difficult" and has argued that Lewis Hamilton has never learned to run a team.

On Sky Sports Germany's Backstage Boxengasse podcast, Schumacher said that Verstappen's deep involvement in the technical side of Red Bull would likely not carry over easily to another team such as Mercedes.
"I think that would be very difficult," the German said. "Max is used to [something different]... He's so technically switched on, he wants to know exactly what's going on.

"He basically gets in the car and wants to know straight away what's happening with the gearbox, with the differential. Or how a damper works, for example. He'd find it interesting to dig into that regardless."

Schumacher put that down to Verstappen's upbringing with his father, former F1 driver Jos Verstappen, comparing it to his own childhood alongside his older brother and seven-time champion Michael Schumacher.
"And Max is also from the generation that grew up with his father, who worked on cars himself, just like it was with me and my brother," he added. "I think that's the big difference."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
He doubts Mercedes would welcome that kind of influence, and thinks Ferrari would be better suited.
"Who did he grow up with, after all? Together with Red Bull. Mercedes is already a big team. If someone like Max went there now, I don't think they'd be too keen on that.
"At Ferrari, I think they're used to a driver being able to make demands, but in my opinion that still comes from Michael [Schumacher], from what he left behind there."
Ferrari's driver line-up dynamics have come under scrutiny in recent races. Schumacher did not hold back in his assessment of Hamilton at the Maranello outfit.

"Hamilton never learned how to lead a team, not under Toto Wolff and not under Ron Dennis," the former driver said. "That was never his job anyway. He just had to get in the car and drive as fast as possible.
"I think you can see that, and I think it's made him quite egotistical as well."

items.summaryEn: Mercedes F1 driver George Russell has launched the GR63 Karting Academy in partnership with Silverstone, open to boys and girls aged eight to nine, aiming to make motorsport more accessible and discover the next young superstar.
detailZh: 这位梅赛德斯F1车手希望让赛车运动在低龄阶段更易参与。
F1明星乔治·拉塞尔与银石合作推出了一所卡丁车学院，旨在让赛车运动更易参与并发掘下一位年轻超级新星。
这位八次大奖赛冠军于周四推出GR63卡丁车学院，面向8至9岁的男孩和女孩开放，设在银石的卡丁车赛道。
学院设有“四阶段通往顶峰之路”，将于12月启动，首阶段为开放报名形式，邀请所有符合条件者前往银石，随后将选出80人进入第二阶段。
这意味着80名车手将于1月31日参加“GR63选拔赛”，以决出25个名额，参加2027年3月至11月在银石赛道举行的八轮锦标赛。
每位车手都将获得全额资助，前五名将在明年12月的第四阶段进行正面交锋，获胜者将获得2028年全额资助的卡丁车赛事机会。
“卡丁车是我一切开始的地方，”拉塞尔说道，他曾在国家和国际级别赢得冠军，之后晋级到单座赛车比赛。
“它教会了我整个职业生涯中所依赖的一切。我知道有天赋的年轻车手获得第一次机会有多难，尤其是在预算紧张的时候。”
“通过GR63卡丁车学院，我想回馈社会，发掘那些隐藏的天才，并为他们提供所需的支持和平台，帮助他们发挥潜力。”
“我非常感谢银石赛道和英国赛车手俱乐部帮助促成此事。”
该学院面向那些“可能没有足够预算在赛车运动中晋级”的人，因为无论是基层还是顶级赛车运动的成本都在增加。
因此，进入学院初始阶段的费用为25英镑，参加“GR63选拔赛”的费用则升至75英镑，而从第三阶段开始，所有费用将得到全额资助。
BRDC 主席大卫·库特哈德表示：“作为银石赛道的所有者以及英国赛车运动的守护者，BRDC 始终致力于对这项运动进行再投资，并培养本土人才。
“这一承诺在英国赛车运动长期的成功记录中发挥了重要作用，也是俱乐部及其会员深感自豪的源泉。
“GR63 学院完美地体现了这一精神，我们很高兴与乔治合作，在银石赛道支持下一代车手。”
所有车手都必须是英联邦国家的公民，如需预约第一阶段（即到场驾驶环节），请点击此处银石赛道网站的链接。
detailEn: The Mercedes F1 driver is hoping to make motorsport more accessible at a young age
Formula 1 star George Russell has launched a karting academy in partnership with Silverstone to make motorsport more accessible and discover the next young superstar.
The eight-time grand prix winner launched his GR63 Karting Academy on Thursday with it open to boys and girls aged eight to nine, based at the kart track in Silverstone.
It features a “four stage path to the top” and will start in December with an open-access format inviting every eligible driver to Silverstone, where 80 will be selected for stage two.
That will see the 80 drivers compete in the “GR63 Shootout” on 31 January to determine the 25 slots for an eight-round championship at Silverstone from March to November in 2027.
The championship is fully-funded for each driver and the top five will go head-to-head in stage four next December, where the winner will receive a fully-funded karting campaign in 2028.
“Karting is where it all started for me,” said Russell, who won titles on a national and international level before progressing into single-seater competition.
“It taught me everything I’ve relied on throughout my career. I know how hard it is for talented young drivers to get that first opportunity, especially when budgets are tight.
“With the GR63 Karting Academy, I want to give something back by finding those hidden talents and giving them the support and platform they need to reach their potential.
“I'm really grateful to Silverstone and the British Racing Drivers’ Club for helping make this happen."
The academy is designed for those who “may not have the budget required to progress through the sport” with the costs in motorsport, both at grassroots level and at the top, increasing.
So costs to enter the academy’s opening stage are £25 with that rising to £75 for the “GR63 Shootout”, before everything is fully-funded from stage three onwards.
BRDC president David Coulthard said: “As owners of Silverstone and guardians of British motorsport, the BRDC has always been committed to reinvesting in the sport and nurturing home-grown talent.
“That commitment has played a big part in Britain’s long record of success in motorsport, and it is a great source of pride for the Club and its Members.
“The GR63 Academy captures that ethos perfectly, and we are delighted to work with George to support the next generation of drivers here at Silverstone."
All drivers must be a citizen of a commonwealth country and to book oneself for stage one, an arrive and drive session, click the link for the Silverstone website here.

items.originalTitle: Ayrton Senna's 1994 Williams F1 car heads to auction with $6million estimate
items.summaryEn: A Williams FW16 driven by three-time Formula 1 champion Ayrton Senna during the 1994 season is going up for auction in New York, with an estimate of $4million to $6million.
detailZh: 艾尔顿·塞纳1994年的威廉姆斯F1赛车将拍卖，估价600万美元
一辆艾尔顿·塞纳在1994年F1赛季驾驶过的威廉姆斯FW16即将在纽约拍卖
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
三届F1世界冠军艾尔顿·塞纳在个人最后一个赛季驾驶过的威廉姆斯FW16赛车将在纽约拍卖。
RM苏富比将在苏富比“现在与当代晚间拍卖”上提供底盘编号FW16B-01，估价为400万至600万美元（295万至445万英镑）。这是该车首次公开出售。
1994年，这位巴西车手从迈凯伦转投威廉姆斯时，格罗夫车队同意，如果赢得当年的车队总冠军，他将获得其中一台底盘。
塞纳不幸在1994年圣马力诺大奖赛中驾驶FW16-02底盘身亡。威廉姆斯随后击败贝纳通夺得车队总冠军，而达蒙·希尔以一分之差将车手总冠军输给了迈克尔·舒马赫。年底，车队信守承诺，将FW16B-01交给了塞纳的家人。
据RM苏富比称，这是塞纳驾驶过的仅存两台FW16之一，尽管他本人从未驾驶该底盘参加比赛。它是赛季揭幕战巴西大奖赛的备用车，但塞纳在英特拉格斯驾驶它参加了正赛日的暖胎练习，并做出了比后来夺冠的舒马赫更快的圈速。
几天后，他和希尔在赫雷斯的测试中共同驾驶了这辆车，在三节测试中总共跑了842公里。
塞纳家族从1994年到2024年拥有FW16B-01，这辆车一直由威廉姆斯车队保管。现任车主通过苏富比拍卖行私下购得。这辆车从未经过修复。
拍卖清单上写道：“FW16B-01底盘在接下来的30年里完全保持原样，唯一的显著例外是加装了塞纳的个人座椅，如今它呈现出完全保存完好、未经修复的状态。”
“现任车主于2024年从塞纳家族通过苏富比拍卖行购得此车，此后它一直保持保存状态，未被使用。”
detailEn: Ayrton Senna's 1994 Williams F1 car heads to auction with $6million estimate
An Ayrton Senna-driven Williams FW16 from the 1994 Formula 1 season is set to go up for auction in New York
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
A Williams FW16 driven by three-time Formula 1 champion Ayrton Senna in his final season in the series is going under the hammer in New York.

RM Sotheby's is offering chassis FW16B-01 in Sotheby's 'The Now & Contemporary Evening Auction', with an estimate of $4million to $6million (£2.95million to £4.45million). It is the first time the car has been put up for public sale.
When the Brazilian driver joined Williams from McLaren in 1994, the Grove outfit agreed that he would receive one of its chassis if it won that year's constructors' championship.

Senna tragically died at the 1994 San Marino Grand Prix, in chassis FW16-02. Williams went on to beat Benetton to the constructors' crown, while Damon Hill lost the drivers' title to Michael Schumacher by a single point. At the end of the year, the team kept its word and gave FW16B-01 to Senna's family.

According to RM Sotheby's, it is one of only two surviving FW16s that Senna drove, although he never raced the chassis himself. It was the spare car at the season-opening Brazilian Grand Prix, but Senna took it out for the race-day warm-up at Interlagos and set a quicker time than Schumacher, who went on to win.
Days later, he and Hill shared it in testing at Jerez, covering 842km across three sessions.
The Senna family owned the FW16B-01 from 1994 until 2024, with the car kept in Williams's care. The current owner bought it privately through RM Sotheby's. It has never been restored.

"Chassis FW16B-01 remained completely untouched for the following 30 years, with a notable exception being the addition of Senna’s personal seat, and is today presented in totally preserved, unrestored condition," the auction listing states.
"Acquired by the current owner in 2024 having been purchased from the Senna family via RM Sotheby’s, it has remained preserved and unused since."
